metadata.title: MatriSync: 162-medicine pair matrix with source-linked draft interaction rules
metadata.assessment_method: Every unordered pair was screened against this limited curated rule set. This is not an independent comprehensive literature or commercial-knowledgebase assessment of every pair. Unmatched pairs remain unresolved.
metadata.severity_method: Editorial three-level classification of potential harm in the stated context, not a validated vendor severity scale or probability estimate. Pair severity is the maximum of its draft rules before patient-context filtering.

source_catalogue.id_policy: All 162 IDs preserved exactly; never renumber.

metadata.india_scope: India-focused medicine identities; interaction evidence uses representative US/UK labels, public-health guidance and selected reports. Indian brands, licences, salts, strengths and product labels are not exhaustively verified.
metadata.pregnancy_scope: Drug-drug interactions are separate from pregnancy suitability, gestational contraindications, fetal risk and breastfeeding. A missing interaction does not imply pregnancy safety.
coverage_limitations: No pair is certified free of interactions.
Additional interactions may exist even for a pair already flagged.
Class mappings and predicted interactions are not proof of a pair-specific clinical event.
Dose-, duration-, route-, indication- and organ-function-dependent conditions require clinical interpretation.
Drug-food, drug-disease, laboratory-test interference and IV admixture compatibility are outside comprehensive coverage.
Multi-drug effects beyond pairs are not evaluated.
Grouped ingredients and fixed-dose products require actual product verification.
release_requirements: Complete and maintain evidence coverage with a suitable authoritative interaction knowledgebase.
Verify actual Indian formulations and combination-product ingredients.
Clinical pharmacist or physician review of every rule, severity and management instruction.
Validate app route/context filtering and unresolved-result handling before clinical deployment.

mild.meaning: Limited or usually transient consequences in the stated context; timing or simple observation may be appropriate.

moderate.meaning: Clinically meaningful adverse effects or loss of efficacy; review, monitoring, timing or clinician-directed adjustment may be required.

severe.meaning: Potential life-threatening, major organ, serious irreversible or treatment-critical harm in the stated context; avoidance or specialist management may be required. It is not an automatic contraindication.

null.meaning: Severity unresolved because this draft has no curated interaction rule for the pair. Never interpret as mild or safe.

status_definitions.draft_interaction_identified: One or more source-linked draft rules apply at medicine-identity level. Read route restrictions, conditions, evidence basis and management before interpreting.
status_definitions.unresolved: No rule in this limited dataset establishes a classification. Other interactions may exist; consult a pharmacist or authoritative interaction reference.

integration.offline_use: JSON imports without network access. Detailed explanations are normalized in rules_by_id; join each pair.rule_ids to those records.
integration.pair_key_algorithm: Validate two distinct catalogue IDs. Sort their full IDs ascending. Return MS-DDI- plus the final four digits of the first ID, a hyphen, and the final four digits of the second.
lookup_order: Resolve names through name_index; ambiguous names require product selection.
Validate both catalogue IDs. Unknown drugs and self-pairs are not no-interaction results.
Construct the unordered pair key and read pairs_by_id.
Join rule_ids to rules_by_id; render all relevant professional or plain_language explanations.
Evaluate each rule route_scope_by_medicine and conditions. Unknown route or context means applicability unresolved.
Only after clinical context review consider severity of applicable rules. Never convert absence of applicable rules into a safe result.

route_handling.included_route: Potentially applicable; still evaluate the rule conditions.
route_handling.unreviewed_route: Rule has not established applicability for this route; do not display a safety clearance.
route_handling.missing_route: Show potential interaction with route verification needed; do not silently discard the rule.

ui_text.unresolved: Interaction information is incomplete for this combination. Check with your clinician or pharmacist.
ui_text.identified: Potential interaction — details and individual clinical review required.
ui_text.self_pair: Same medicine selected twice: check total dose and duplicate products.
ui_text.unknown_drug: Medicine not covered by this dataset.
ui_text.general_action: Do not stop, start or change prescribed treatment solely from this checker.

integration.duplicate_ingredient_policy: potential_shared_ingredients is a separate formulation-check hint, not a severity classification. Verify actual route, strength and total exposure. The three hints are not an exhaustive ingredient-duplication engine.
integration.index_policy: Each interaction pair is stored once. pair_ids_by_medicine repeats references only, allowing either medicine to find the same record.
